algorithm: For each distinct ordered-by-size offset pair, enumerate u with u*u < 2*(q-p)/c; retain exact divisors v of opposite parity whose recovered indices meet kMin. Group every pair solution by value into complete fibers. Save all pairs including empty solutions.
outputs: Every pair record, complete collision fibers, mode summaries and actual work counters.
reader: New exact branch prefix counts using BigInt square roots; saved collision correction for arbitrary palette masks; inclusive windows, numeric ranks/selects, representation fibers and multiplicity profiles. Bank each request/response and caches before proceeding.
exclusions: No primality, sieve or accepted Pell/Fibonacci computation
No conjecture, novelty, priority or prize claim
checkpoints: Source/input/plan/source qualification before one construction; complete certificate before reader; reader plan before queries; complete reader before publication spec.
